test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

Some pliers are levers

All levers are ramps

Some cutters are pliers.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some cutters are levers 

(II) Some ramps are cutters

(III) All pliers are ramps

options.text: Either conclusion I or III follows

solution:
Given Statements: 

Some pliers are levers

All levers are ramps

Some cutters are pliers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d225144a0e14114bd14d1a5d4f43f43c6ba535b04e6dd5027161fad1ef59af6d.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some cutters are levers → False (No direct relationship given between cutters and levers so, it is possible but not definite)

(II) Some ramps are cutters → False (No direct relationship given between ramps and cutters so, it is possible but not definite)

(III) All pliers are ramps → False (No direct relationship given between pliers and ramps so, it is possible but not definite)

Thus, None of the Conclusions follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
